trials.reasoning: Buyers describe receiving great value from the lifetime deal and unlimited coverage through AppSumo. The complaints about one Mac setup and lack of new features do not show lifetime access was denied.

exhibits.quote: This tool never worked on my mac inspite of giving all the permissions it needs.
exhibits.argument: If the tool never works despite permissions, lifetime access provides no usable value.

exhibits.quote: Based on the reviews, there have been a few feature request going back to 2021, but it doesn't appear that any new features have been added.
exhibits.argument: Lack of any new features since 2021 undermines the value of promised lifetime access and updates.

exhibits.quote: Great value for a lifetime deal.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms receiving lifetime deal value as promised.

exhibits.quote: I have already tried it, I am very happy to have such unlimited coverage through appsumo.
exhibits.argument: Unlimited coverage through AppSumo supports lifetime access claim.

trials.claim: Quickly set a reminder to revisit important websites at the perfect time
trials.claimQuote: Quickly set a reminder to revisit important websites at the perfect time
trials.reasoning: Two buyers say reminders take just a few clicks and bring them back at the right time. The criticism about extra steps or missed reminders does not outweigh this direct support for quick setting.

exhibits.quote: This means there is more than a 2-step process to make sure you go back to the site, which negates the point of the extension (IMHO).
exhibits.argument: More than 2-step process contradicts claim of quickly setting a reminder at the perfect time.

exhibits.quote: However, if for some reason you miss the reminder, it's gone.
exhibits.argument: If a missed reminder is gone with no history, it fails to reliably revisit important websites.

exhibits.quote: In just a few clicks, set a reminder to a specific tab you want to work on after some time
exhibits.argument: Confirms quickly setting a reminder to revisit a tab at a chosen time.

exhibits.quote: Just click, set the reminder, and it brings me back at the right time.
exhibits.argument: Shows the reminder brings user back to important website at perfect time.
